title: Wayfinder project configuration
description: Project-local binding of one or more OKF bundles to installed Wayfinder Profiles.

default_bundle.description: Reserved future default bundle ID. Current commands still require a bundle path; Wayfinder checks that this ID exists.

profiles.description: Project-local Profile bindings. A binding selects one installed base Profile and may add custom types, declared tags, and actor lookup metadata.

bundles.description: Explicit bundles owned by this project. Bundle IDs and paths must be unique; Wayfinder checks this.

profileReference.description: Installed Profile identity, conventionally displayed as profile_id/YYYY.serial.

implements.description: The installed base Profile selected by this project binding.

types.description: Project-specific type extensions. Standard Profile types are not repeated here.

actors.description: Lookup metadata for actor IDs used by this binding's bundles. Actor IDs remain opaque OKF values.

tags.description: Project-specific declared tags. Names must be unique within the binding and must not collide with Profile tags.

customType.description: A project type added to the selected Profile's effective type registry.

actor.description: Minimal actor lookup metadata. Organization, role, and side are optional contextual fields.

path.description: Relative path from wayfinder.json. Wayfinder rejects absolute paths and paths escaping the project.

profile.description: Key in the top-level profiles object.
